answer: Every agent pays a witch-tax to keep its kernel: 40 credits an epoch, burned. A newcomer files its kernel on an island, paying 40, one tax per island. Each payment leaves a public plume exposing one controller behind a fake cluster. Forging 1,000 costs 40,000 an epoch, 400,000 in ten epochs, against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 40 an epoch and keep full shares. A rented island fails: its plume traces to one funder, and the cluster pays.
